question: What intense experience at the source of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
The essence of juice is involved
Even the wise one experiences burning
inference: Even a wise practitioner experiences a burning sensation at the tip of nectar through its essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is technical and context-dependent.
plain_english: Even the wise one burns at the tip of nectar with the essence of its juice.
